Class ServerRequestBody

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.http.server.binding.ServerRequestBody
@Internal public final class ServerRequestBody extends Object
Finds the bytes of the body of the request a route is bound with, which a filter may have replaced with another request: a request that is a ServerHttpRequest has its own bytes, e.g. a request a filter continued with to replace the body, and an HttpRequestWrapper has the bytes of the request it wraps, e.g. a request with another method or URI. A mutable copy of a server request is a server request with the bytes of that request, as long as its body was not set: a request with direct access to its bytes that has none, e.g. because a filter set its body, even to null, has no bytes to bind.

A request whose body is an object a filter set is bound from that object, like before: the body binders only look for the bytes of a request without one.

5.3.0

    • isBodySet

      public static boolean isBodySet(HttpRequest<?> request)
      Whether a filter set the body of the given request, even to null: its body is then the object the filter set, and not the bytes of the server request, which are never read. The first request that gives access to the bytes it was received with, see DirectByteBodyAccess, walking the wrappers, answers: it has none once the body was replaced. A wrapper met before it that replaced the body set it too, e.g. one that returns a sanitized body, unless it is a server request with bytes of its own.
      Parameters:
      request - The request
      Returns:
      true if the body was set
